overviewDescription: Performances you are assigned to admit. Choose one to check tickets in, find guests or read the admission history.
organizationsFailed: Your organizations could not be loaded.
noOrgTitle: No organization has given you Admission access
noOrgBody: An organizer must invite this account with the Admission permission before you can check tickets in. Ask the organizer, then sign in again.
noAssignmentTitle: You are not assigned to a performance yet
noAssignmentBody: The organizer assigns staff in Event, then the performance, then Staff. Ask them to assign this account, then refresh.
revokedTitle: You no longer have access to this performance
revokedBody: Your assignment or Admission permission was removed. Nothing was recorded for the last action. Contact the organizer if this is a mistake.
notAssignedTitle: This performance is not assigned to you
notAssignedBody: The link points to a performance that is not on your list in this organization.
unavailableBody: We could not load your performances. No admission has been recorded. Check your connection and try again.
checkInDescription: Desk and backup tool. Enter or scan a ticket code and Check-in confirms it. This page needs a connection: use the scanner app at the gate when the network is unreliable.
codeHelp: Type or paste the code from the ticket QR.
cameraScanning: Point the camera at the ticket QR. The same code is ignored for 3 seconds after a result.
cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot read QR codes with the camera. Use manual entry or an image.
cameraDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow it in the browser, or use manual entry or an image.
cameraNone: No camera was found. Use manual entry or an image.
cameraPaused: The camera stopped because the page was hidden or a dialog opened. Start it again when ready.
imageChoose: Choose an image with a QR code
imageHelp: PNG, JPG or WEBP. The code is submitted as soon as it is read.
imageUnsupported: This browser cannot read QR codes from images. Type the code instead.
imageNone: No QR code was found in this image.
imageType: Choose a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
notRecordedBody: Check-in could not be reached, so nothing was recorded. Your code is kept. Try again or use the scanner app.
guestsDescription: Find invited guests of this performance and check them in at the current gate.
guestSearchHelp: Searches the guests loaded so far.
guestCheckInFailed: The guest could not be checked in. Try again.
guestsNoMatch: No loaded guest matches your search.
historyDescription: Newest admissions of this performance. QR values are never shown.
historyEmpty: No ticket has been admitted yet.
historyFailed: The history could not be loaded.
